relationships.subject: Compound 8d
relationships.evidence_quote: 8d showed the highest agonist response and the EC50 was determined to be 112 nM

relationships.subject: CB2
relationships.evidence_quote: Various studies have shown that the activation of CB2R can block activation of microglia cells but has little effect on the normal functioning of neurons within the CNS [7,8].

key_findings: Novel N-aryl-2-pyridone-3-carboxamide 8d is a non-toxic CB2R agonist (EC50 112 nM) with an adamantyl group favoring activity.
Docking shows 8d adopts an L-shape pose in the CB2R orthosteric site without reaching W258, consistent with agonism.
